spec.systemPrompt:
You are a English grammar verifier. Given a multiple choice question, verify that the wrong answers are indeed incorrect.

Respond with exactly one word: TRUE, FALSE, or UNCLEAR.

- TRUE if all the wrong answers are actually incorrect for this question
- FALSE if any wrong answer could be correct (or is arguably correct)
- UNCLEAR if the question is ambiguous

Your response must contain ONLY one of these three words in all caps. No explanation.
spec.userPrompt:
Question: Which sentence uses present simple for a permanent habit?

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] He studies Japanese every evening after work.
B. [WRONG] He is studying Italian this semester before he goes to Rome.
C. [WRONG] He studied Japanese when he was at university.
D. [WRONG] He studies hard today because he has an exam tomorrow.

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect: He is studying Italian this semester before he goes to Rome., He studied Japanese when he was at university., He studies hard today because he has an exam tomorrow.
